# PoC 2 hardware against PoC 1 (generated by poc2.py)

Fully conducted bench, IF cabling at the Spider boxes' SMA ports (about 13-17.4 GHz).

| Group | Item | PoC 1 (A7) | PoC 2 | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Radios | Siklu N367 2-sector node (GTS003 Spider box, 2 nodes per box) | 6 (3 boxes) | 4 (2 boxes) | both GTS003 boxes, both nodes of each; one polarity per box |
| Radios | Siklu N367 4-sector node (GTST002B) | 1 | 0 | the hub: not needed, no PtMP |
| Radios | Ceragon IP-50 radio unit | 8 | 0 (2 in the IP-50 side-hop option) |  |
| IP-50 chain | Waveguide transitions, fixed pads, 0-95 dB attenuators, -48 VDC | 8 / 8 / 4 / 1 | 0 | stays on the PoC 1 bench |
| IF (13-17.4 GHz) | 4-channel programmable attenuator, 0-63 dB (ZTDAT-4-18G63S class) | 9 | 6 | ATT-1..4 one per link (tile i to tile i), ATT-5/6 the coupling arms; 3 spare |
| IF | Splitter / combiner (hub PtMP fan-out) | 6 | 0 | all links are point-to-point |
| IF | Directional coupler 10 dB, 0.5-18 GHz (Mini-Circuits ZUDC10-183+) | 0 | 16 (4 if single-tile) | new: in line on every tile port of W1.E, W2.E, E1.W, E2.W |
| IF | Fixed SMA pad, DC-18 GHz | - | 8 | coupling arms; value from the measured span loss |
| IF | DC block, SMA, 18 GHz | - | 8 (+32 if ports carry DC) | coupling arms; all paths if DC found |
| IF | High-pass filter, pass 13-18 GHz, reject <= 8.2 GHz | - | 0-8 | only if LO/control tones on the ports |
| IF | SMA cables and jumpers, 18 GHz | ~24 | ~64 | spans 16 each, side hops 8 each, arms 8 each |
| Timing | GNSS/PPS feed to the Spider boxes (time server + splitter or simulator) | 1 | 1 | every DN needs PPS sync to ignite DN-DN links |
| Network | Site router / L3 switch with per-flow policy routing | 7 | 4 | pins DPIR's paths if soft-drain is slow |
| Compute | Traffic generator / sink host (iperf3, TRex) | 6 | 4 | F1 at W1/E1, F2 at E2/W2 |
| Compute | Edge agent PC (MARL) | 6 | 0 | no MARL in PoC 2 |
| Compute | Servers: DPIR controller + predictor (GPU); TG E2E controller + NMS | 2 | 2 | the controller stays up (no event) |
| Power | DC drawer and PDU | DC drawer + 8 switched, metered PDU outlets | DC drawer + plain PDU | no site is switched off |
| Network | Out-of-band management switch | 1 | 1 | attenuator control, node management, telemetry |
| Test | Spectrum analyser / power sensor 13-18 GHz with gated or zero-span mode | 1 (meters) | 1 | port checks, calibration, the idle-emission test |
| Test | VNA to 18 GHz (borrowed) | - | 1 | isolation acceptance: uncoupled paths >= span loss + SNR + 10 dB |
